registry_info.name: procgen_extra
registry_info.description: Additional procedural generation artifacts â€” wave function collapse, higher-dimensional polytopes, reaction diffusion, and maze generation. The constructive side of algorithms.
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Constraint satisfaction (WFC), higher-dimensional geometry (tesseracts, penteracts), Turing patterns, maze generation algorithms

wfc.name: Wave Function Collapse
wfc.description: Wave Function Collapse algorithm â€” generating complex patterns from local adjacency constraints. Start with superposition of all possibilities, observe one tile, propagate constraints until the world resolves.

reaction_diffusion.name: Reaction Diffusion
reaction_diffusion.description: Turing pattern generation using reaction-diffusion systems â€” the Gray-Scott model on a 2D grid producing spots, stripes, and labyrinthine patterns from two interacting chemicals.

reaction_diffusion_vr.name: Reaction Diffusion (VR)
reaction_diffusion_vr.description: Turing reaction-diffusion patterns in VR â€” two chemicals activating and inhibiting each other, producing spots, stripes, and labyrinthine patterns. The math behind animal markings.

tesseract_tunnel.name: Tesseract Tunnel
tesseract_tunnel.description: Fly through a tunnel of rotating tesseracts â€” 4D hypercubes projected into 3D, their inner and outer cubes visible simultaneously. Experience the shadow of a higher dimension.

penteract_double_projection.name: Penteract Double Projection
penteract_double_projection.description: 5D hypercube (penteract) projected twice â€” from 5D to 4D to 3D. The shadow of a shadow of a higher-dimensional object, revealing structure invisible from any single viewpoint.

maze_generator.name: Maze Generator
maze_generator.description: Procedural maze generation â€” watch walls carve out paths through depth-first search, recursive backtracking, or randomized algorithms. Every maze is a spanning tree of a grid graph.

room_grammar.name: Room Grammar
room_grammar.description: Shape grammar for architectural floor plans â€” binary space partitioning recursively splits a rectangle into rooms, draws wall outlines, adds door gaps, and colors rooms by area. The algorithmic foundation behind roguelike dungeon generation.

terrain_erosion.name: Terrain Erosion
terrain_erosion.description: Hydraulic erosion on a procedural heightmap â€” layered sin-wave terrain eroded by 800 virtual water droplets flowing downhill, carrying and depositing sediment. ImmediateMesh surface colored by altitude: water, beach, grass, rock, snow.

cave_generator.name: Cave Generator
cave_generator.description: Cellular automaton cave generation with flood-fill connectivity â€” classic roguelike technique. 64x64 grid initialized with random walls, smoothed by CA rules (5+ neighbors = wall), then flood-filled to keep only the largest connected region. Entrance and exit markers placed at region extremes.

genetic_programming.name: Genetic Programming
genetic_programming.description: Genetic programming interface for evolving 3D shapes â€” populations of genomes (Primitives, CSG Trees, Parametric, Voxel, L-Systems) undergo selection, crossover, and mutation toward fitness goals like target volume, height, and symmetry. Visualizes the entire population in a grid with real-time evolution.

flower_lab.name: Flower Lab
flower_lab.description: Interactive botanical laboratory â€” VR sliders control petal count, length, width, curve, stem height, color hue, leaf count, and symmetry of a procedural BotanicalFlower. Randomize to discover unexpected morphologies, save presets to JSON. Teaches how parametric variation drives flower form.

ik_arm_demo.name: IK Arm Demo
ik_arm_demo.description: Standalone TwoBoneIK3D arm demonstration — two procedural arms with animated targets tracing figure-8 patterns. Shows the same inverse kinematics solver used for VR body tracking.

torso_estimation_vis.name: Torso Estimation Visualization
torso_estimation_vis.description: 3-point torso estimation demo — shows how head + two hand positions estimate torso orientation. Animated tracking points with visible shoulder computation and forward direction.

mirror_artifact.name: Mirror Artifact
mirror_artifact.description: Reflective mirror panel showing the player what their hands look like. A large vertical mirror surface with metallic material and decorative wooden frame.

necklace_anchor.name: Necklace Anchor
necklace_anchor.description: Pendant necklace display on a stand showing the concept of an identity anchor point. A vertical stand with torus ring, glowing gem pendant that slowly rotates.

dress_selector.name: Dress Selector
dress_selector.description: Outfit selection interface with three mannequin display forms in Classic, Wicked, and Custom styles. Each mannequin has a selection button for choosing an outfit.

botanical_flower.name: Botanical Flower
botanical_flower.description: Standalone procedural flower — configurable petal count, length, width, curve, stem height, color hue, leaf count, and symmetry. A lightweight wrapper around the BotanicalFlower generator for map placement without VR controls.

water_flowers.name: Water Flowers
water_flowers.description: Floating flowers on physically simulated Gerstner waves — buoyancy, wave alignment, and drift create a mesmerizing water garden. Configurable flower count, water size, wave strength, and drift speed.
